AMUD UI/telemetry stabilization patch.

This release finalizes host telemetry behavior and app status mapping after the `v1.4.2.0` rollout.

---

## Fixed

- Host-based apps such as **Beszel** and **Filebrowser** now map correctly even when they are not LXC containers.
- Proxmox card status now follows **host agent connectivity** instead of failing URL-only checks (removes false OFFLINE badges).
- App-to-container matching improved with normalized aliases and URL token fallback.

## Improved

- Dashboard telemetry row now clearly shows **CPU, RAM, GPU (if available), Disk, and Bandwidth**.
- `/telemetry` page now shows richer AMUD-style details and a live services table.
- Guest (not logged in) app cards render compactly to avoid oversized rows.

---

## Upgrade

```bash
curl -sSL https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/releases/latest/download/update-amud.sh | bash
```

Verify **Settings → System** shows `v1.4.2.1`.
